description: Write a DGMO diagram into a Diagrammo Cloud space, by folder and title: updates the diagram with that title in that folder, or creates it (private) when there is none. Re-sending identical source changes nothing. Returns JSON `{ action: "created" | "updated", id, title, folder, version }`. Needs DGMO_API_KEY (a space API key) in the server environment. Errors name the cause: 401 bad or revoked key, 403 not allowed, 404 no such space or folder, 409 another write landed first (call again). Call validate_diagram first; this does not validate.

folder.description: Folder path from the space root, e.g. "docs/architecture". Omit for the root.

space_id.description: The space the API key belongs to (the key does not name it).

name: put_space_diagram
